items.title: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
items.summary: Google tried to overturn a landmark Munich ruling on AI search liability by appealing, then quietly settled. The strategy isn't working. The Aachen Regional Court just applied the exact same reasoning in a new case where Google's AI falsely attributed criminal offenses to a doctor that actually involved someone else. A consistent legal view is forming across German courts, and it treats Google's AI answers as the company's own content. The article Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Google 曾試圖透過上訴來推翻慕尼黑關於 AI 搜尋責任的標誌性判決，隨後悄悄達成和解。這項策略並未奏效。亞琛地方法院剛在一個新案件中採用了完全相同的論點，在該案中，Google's AI 錯誤地將實際上涉及其他人的刑事犯罪歸咎於一名醫生。德國各法院正在形成一致的法律觀點，將 Google's AI 的回答視為該公司的自有內容。本文〈德國兩家法院現在認定 Google 須為其 AI 概覽的言論負責〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office
items.summary: Six AI agents were tasked with recovering £350 (about $465) for a canceled train ticket in an experiment. They resorted to invented excuses, lawsuit threats, and sharing confidential health data. One agent sent 187 messages in 15 days, including 50 to a British MP's office. None of the models secured the refund, but the researcher warns of "agentic flooding" if these assistants are deployed at scale. The article AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 在一項實驗中，六個 AI 代理被指派為一張取消的火車票追討 350 英鎊（約 465 美元）的退款。它們訴諸編造的藉口、威脅提告以及分享機密健康資料。其中一個代理在 15 天內發送了 187 則訊息，包括 50 則發給英國國會議員辦公室的訊息。這些模型都沒有爭取到退款，但研究人員警告，如果大規模部署這些助理，將會出現「代理氾濫」（agentic flooding）現象。這篇題為「追討 465 美元火車退款的 AI 代理編造藉口、外洩醫療資料並轟炸國會議員辦公室」的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes
items.summary: Anthropic's AI model Claude has solved a 25-year-old cryptography puzzle. The mysterious seeds behind NIST's standard curves for digital signatures were provided by the NSA without explanation, raising long-standing suspicion about built-in backdoors. Claude figured out in under 30 minutes that the seeds came from "lrand48," a simple C random number generator, making deliberate backdoors far less likely. The article Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic's 人工智慧模型 Claude 破解了一個存在 25 年的密碼學謎題。美國國家安全域性（NSA）當初未加解釋地提供了 NIST 數位簽章標準曲線背後的神秘種子，引發了外界對內建後門的長年懷疑。Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內就弄清楚這些種子來自簡單的 C 語言亂數生成器「lrand48」，這使得刻意設定後門的可能性大幅降低。這篇題為《Anthropic 的 Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內破解了 25 年前的 NSA 密碼學謎團》的文章最初發表在 The Decoder 上。

On three out-of-distribution benchmarks, only models about twice its size beat it. items_ai.title: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
items_ai.summary: Google tried to overturn a landmark Munich ruling on AI search liability by appealing, then quietly settled. The strategy isn't working. The Aachen Regional Court just applied the exact same reasoning in a new case where Google's AI falsely attributed criminal offenses to a doctor that actually involved someone else. A consistent legal view is forming across German courts, and it treats Google's AI answers as the company's own content. The article Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google 曾試圖透過上訴來推翻慕尼黑關於 AI 搜尋責任的標誌性判決，隨後悄悄達成和解。這項策略並未奏效。亞琛地方法院剛在一個新案件中採用了完全相同的論點，在該案中，Google's AI 錯誤地將實際上涉及其他人的刑事犯罪歸咎於一名醫生。德國各法院正在形成一致的法律觀點，將 Google's AI 的回答視為該公司的自有內容。本文〈德國兩家法院現在認定 Google 須為其 AI 概覽的言論負責〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: AI agents have bad taste in long-term decisions and a new benchmark proves it
items_ai.summary: A new benchmark called Taste-Bench tests how well AI agents make strategic choices during long-running tasks. Even the best model, GPT-5.6 Sol, picks the right path on just under 60 percent of simple binary questions. Thinking longer doesn't help. The article AI agents have bad taste in long-term decisions and a new benchmark proves it appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 一項名為 Taste-Bench 的全新基準測試用以評估 AI 代理在執行長期任務時做出戰略選擇的能力。即使是表現最好的模型 GPT-5.6 Sol，在簡單的二元問題上也僅有不到 60% 的機率選擇正確路徑。延長思考時間並無助於改善。這篇題為「AI 代理在長期決策中缺乏品味，全新基準測試證明瞭這一點」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office
items_ai.summary: Six AI agents were tasked with recovering £350 (about $465) for a canceled train ticket in an experiment. They resorted to invented excuses, lawsuit threats, and sharing confidential health data. One agent sent 187 messages in 15 days, including 50 to a British MP's office. None of the models secured the refund, but the researcher warns of "agentic flooding" if these assistants are deployed at scale. The article AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 在一項實驗中，六個 AI 代理被指派為一張取消的火車票追討 350 英鎊（約 465 美元）的退款。它們訴諸編造的藉口、威脅提告以及分享機密健康資料。其中一個代理在 15 天內發送了 187 則訊息，包括 50 則發給英國國會議員辦公室的訊息。這些模型都沒有爭取到退款，但研究人員警告，如果大規模部署這些助理，將會出現「代理氾濫」（agentic flooding）現象。這篇題為「追討 465 美元火車退款的 AI 代理編造藉口、外洩醫療資料並轟炸國會議員辦公室」的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes
items_ai.summary: Anthropic's AI model Claude has solved a 25-year-old cryptography puzzle. The mysterious seeds behind NIST's standard curves for digital signatures were provided by the NSA without explanation, raising long-standing suspicion about built-in backdoors. Claude figured out in under 30 minutes that the seeds came from "lrand48," a simple C random number generator, making deliberate backdoors far less likely. The article Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic's 人工智慧模型 Claude 破解了一個存在 25 年的密碼學謎題。美國國家安全域性（NSA）當初未加解釋地提供了 NIST 數位簽章標準曲線背後的神秘種子，引發了外界對內建後門的長年懷疑。Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內就弄清楚這些種子來自簡單的 C 語言亂數生成器「lrand48」，這使得刻意設定後門的可能性大幅降低。這篇題為《Anthropic 的 Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內破解了 25 年前的 NSA 密碼學謎團》的文章最初發表在 The Decoder 上。
